Metastable high-pressure silica polymorph containing penta- and hexa-coordinated Si. The material and phase identity are retained, but no executable EOS is distributed: Supplementary Table 11 reports K0 and K0\_prime while omitting the required V0, and Supplementary Table 10 supplies only one integer-pressure P-V anchor. The held candidate and its sensitivity-bounded diagnostic reconstruction are preserved under source.held\_eos\_candidate for provenance only.
